name: Basic Layouts
description: Provides a set of basic layout plugins for Layout Builder.
project_description:
The basic Layouts module provides a handful of layouts as well as the ability to customize their settings through the Layout Builder Styles and Layout Builder Sections Config dependencies.

 
 Features
 
 
 
 Provides 5 basic layouts predefined out-of-the-box to be used in Layout Builder.
 
 
 One Column
 
 
 One Column (Grid)
 
 
 Two Columns
 
 
 Three Columns
 
 
 Four Columns
 
 
 
 
 Layouts can be enabled or disabled in each content type.
 
 
 Layouts are customizable with Layout Builder Styles and Layout Builder Sections Config modules.
 
 
 Option to disable core layouts
 
 
 
 Post Installation
 
 
 
 Enable the layouts you need or disable the ones you don’t in each content type in the Manage Display settings.
 
 
 Optionally disable core layouts by visiting Configuration > Content Authoring > Basic layouts config
